svg.title: BlockManagerDecommissioner -- YARN Node Decommission Migration
svg.desc: ESS OFF requirement (YarnAllocator.scala:192-202), RM DECOMMISSIONING signal, RDD & shuffle peer migration, and metadata updates. 1. ResourceManager to YarnAllocator: NodeReport(DECOMMISSIONING) (rm01:8030); 2. YarnAllocator to DriverSchedBackend: decommissionExecutorsOnHost (driver-1 in-JVM); 3. DriverSchedBackend to ExecutorBackend: DecommissionExecutor (driver-1:41000); 4. ExecutorBackend to BM Decommissioner: decommissionBlockManager() (worker-a in-JVM); 5. BM Decommissioner to BlockTransferSvc: uploadBlockSync (per block) (worker-a in-JVM); 6. BlockTransferSvc to Peer BlockMgr B: UploadBlock(rdd_17_3) (worker-b:42002); 7. BlockTransferSvc to Peer BlockMgr B: UploadBlockStream(.data) (worker-b:42002); 8. BlockTransferSvc to Peer BlockMgr B: UploadBlockStream(.index) (worker-b:42002); 9. Peer BlockMgr B to BlockManagerMaster: UpdateBlockInfo(RDD+Index) (driver-1:41000); 10. BlockManagerMaster to MapOutputMaster: updateMapOutput(s=4, m=0) (driver-1 in-JVM)
